variant.title: Dynamic Index Operator Fixture
variant.description: A technical reference for selecting one cell from an ordered sequence by another cell's digit.
rule_guide.title: Dynamic Index Reference Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Read the digit in the index cell as a position from 1 through 9 in the ordered sequence.
rule_guide.item_3: The digit in the selected sequence cell must equal the target value.
